research_question: What is the effect of elective neck dissection compared with therapeutic neck dissection on disease-free survival in adults with early-stage oral cavity squamous cell carcinoma and a clinically node-negative neck?
treatment_label: Elective neck dissection (immediate / prophylactic neck dissection at primary surgery)
control_label: Therapeutic neck dissection (delayed dissection / observation with dissection on nodal relapse)
outcome_description: Disease-free survival (DFS; also termed event-free, relapse-free, or recurrence-free survival), defined as time to locoregional recurrence, distant metastasis, disease progression, or death from any cause, pooled as a hazard ratio (HR) comparing elective neck dissection to therapeutic neck dissection.
positive_direction: A lower hazard ratio (HR < 1, or log HR < 0), corresponding to a positive effect size favoring elective neck dissection, indicates prolonged disease-free survival and reduced risk of disease recurrence, progression, or death.
search_queries: "elective neck dissection" "therapeutic neck dissection" "oral cavity" "disease-free survival" trial
"prophylactic neck dissection" "early oral" "observation" randomized controlled trial
"elective versus therapeutic neck dissection" oral tongue cancer survival trial
inclusion_criteria: Randomized controlled trials enrolling adults with early-stage (T1-T2, cN0) oral cavity (including oral tongue) squamous cell carcinoma.
Intervention comparison evaluating elective (immediate/prophylactic) neck dissection versus therapeutic (watchful waiting / observation with dissection upon relapse) neck dissection.
Reporting of disease-free survival (or recurrence-free, relapse-free, event-free survival) with hazard ratio and 95% CI or sufficient data to estimate the log hazard ratio and its standard error.
exclusion_criteria: Not an original empirical study (systematic reviews, meta-analyses, narrative reviews, editorials, commentaries, and book chapters are excluded).
Non-randomized studies, retrospective or prospective observational cohorts, and single-arm studies (only randomized controlled trials are included).
Studies not comparing elective neck dissection against therapeutic (observation/delayed) neck dissection, such as trials investigating sentinel node biopsy alone or radiation therapy alone.

Lack of quantitative disease-free survival data (studies reporting only overall survival, recurrence rates without time-to-event data, or lacking sufficient information to calculate or estimate a hazard ratio).
moderators_to_extract: Primary tumor subsite (oral tongue vs other oral cavity subsites)
T category distribution (proportion T1 vs T2)
Extent of elective neck dissection (e.g. supraomohyoid / selective levels I-III vs modified radical)
Use of adjuvant radiotherapy or chemoradiotherapy
effect_size_note: Extract the hazard ratio (HR) and 95% confidence interval for disease-free survival (or relapse-free / event-free survival), preferring the intention-to-treat (ITT) analysis and longest available follow-up. Convert 95% CI to SE(log HR). Orient the comparison as elective vs therapeutic (HR < 1 favors elective neck dissection; invert HR and swap CI bounds if reported as therapeutic vs elective). If HR is not directly reported, calculate HR and its variance using Parmar or Peto log-rank / O-E methods from reported log-rank p-values and event counts. Do not substitute overall survival alone.
